svg.title: 03 · Query path
svg.desc: The run worker sends SQL over Quack to the DuckDB query service, which alone holds customer B's 15-minute STS credentials and reads only customer B's gold; Customer A is denied by the API and by IAM.
svg.text: RUN WORKER · FARGATE · NO AWS CREDENTIALS
The agent never holds AWS credentials. Only the query service does, for 15 minutes.
